_README: Copy this file to credentials.json (same directory) and fill in real values. credentials.json is git-ignored and must NEVER be committed. Every key can also be supplied as an environment variable instead — see algos/shared/credentials.py for the exact names.
_telegram_token: From @BotFather: /newbot, then copy the HTTP API token. Env: LWG_TELEGRAM_TOKEN
_telegram_chat_id: The GROUP the bots broadcast to (negative number, e.g. -1001234567890). Add the bot to the group, send a message, then read chat.id from https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates. Env: LWG_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
_deadman_url: The EXTERNAL dead-man's switch ping URL, e.g. https://hc-ping.com/<uuid> from a free healthchecks.io check. algos/notifications/deadman.py pings it every 5 minutes ONLY while the bots are healthy, so the ABSENCE of a ping is what alerts you - the one failure no on-box alert can report, because a dead VPS cannot tell you it died. Treat it as a SECRET: anyone holding it can send your pings for you and keep the alert permanently green. Leave empty to run without one (supported - the script says so and exits 0). Env: LWG_DEADMAN_URL
_telegram_admin_chat_id: Your PERSONAL chat id (positive number) for critical alerts. Same getUpdates trick, from a direct message to the bot. Env: LWG_TELEGRAM_ADMIN_CHAT_ID
_mt5_accounts: Per-account MT5 logins, keyed by account number as a STRING: {"12345678": {"password": "...", "server": "VantageMarkets-Demo"}}. A live bot names its account in its own instance config and the password is looked up here, so the two never travel together and one credentials file serves every bot on the machine.
_per_bot_telegram: A bot can report to its OWN group, as its OWN Telegram identity, without any change to this file's shape. The destination is a plain chat id in the bot's instance config (telegram_chat_id). A separate identity is a key added HERE and NAMED there (telegram_token_key), e.g. "telegram_token_bleg": "<token from a second BotFather bot>" — env: LWG_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_BLEG. Any key works; the env name is always LWG_<KEY IN CAPS>. Leave both empty on a bot and it uses the shared token and group above.
